en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a small town in a wide alpine valley, surrounded by tall mountains with some snow on the peaks. The foreground shows clusters of red‑roofed houses and a church with a white bell tower. Fields and roads stretch across the flat valley floor toward dark green mountains in the background. The word "Caldonazzo." is printed in the lower left corner, and a small number "04912" appears in the upper right.
